cards.title: UK Warns AI-Driven Cyberattacks Exploit Weak Security
cards.body: British cyber agency says AI hacking tools rely on exploiting simple security flaws. Building strong foundations is now critical as threats evolve.

cards.title: Meta Integrates Muse AI Assistant Into Instagram DMs
cards.body: Users can now interact with Muse directly in Instagram messages without toggling between apps. The integration streamlines the AI assistant experience for Meta's platform.

cards.title: Tidal Bans Fully AI-Generated Tracks From Platform
cards.body: The music streaming service will remove AI-generated content while permitting songs made with AI assistance. The move addresses the influx of AI-generated music flooding services.

cards.title: Crusoe Investor Backs Solar Power for AI Data Centers
cards.body: Next-generation data centers will require tens of gigawatts annually, necessitating renewable energy solutions. Solar and energy storage offer practical alternatives to traditional power sources.

cards.title: Pinterest Lets Parents Limit Teen AI-Generated Content
cards.body: The platform addresses AI content in teen feeds rather than restricting chatbot access. Parents gain new controls over algorithmic content exposure.

cards.title: Amazon Acquires Decart for $7.5B Chip Efficiency
cards.body: The acquisition aims to improve Amazon's Trainium chips and narrow the silicon gap with Nvidia. Decart's AI optimization technology strengthens Amazon's competitive position.

cards.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Ship for Code Review
cards.body: Claude Ship enables AI agents to review, fix, and approve code changes automatically. The tool eliminates bottlenecks in developer workflows handling AI-generated code.

cards.title: Supertake Raises $20M for AI-Powered Stock Portfolio
cards.body: The startup transforms market predictions into AI-managed stock portfolios without manual stock selection. Supertake automates investment strategy execution based on user insights.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Reinstated as Nvidia CEO
cards.body: Nvidia's board reversed course and restored Huang following support from senior U.S. government officials. Huang told employees he will be a better CEO this time.

cards.title: Megaspeed Faces US Blacklist Over Huang Scandal
cards.body: The company previously led by Alice Huang will be barred from U.S. business without federal license approval. The move follows allegations involving suspected Chinese espionage connections.

cards.title: Nvidia Employees Celebrate Huang's Return as CEO
cards.body: Huang received a hero's welcome at company headquarters upon his reinstatement. He pledged improved leadership during his return to the CEO role.

cards.title: Google Search AI Mode Integrates Drive and Wallet
cards.body: AI Mode now leverages user data from Drive, Wallet, and Gemini app for personalized responses. The integration enhances Google's Personal Intelligence capabilities across services.

cards.title: Jensen Huang to Testify Before Senate Next Week
cards.body: A public hearing follows bipartisan calls for Huang to address alleged contact with suspected Chinese spy. The testimony relates to circumstances surrounding his temporary removal.

cards.title: Experts Warn Huang's Return Still Poses Risks
cards.body: Tech leaders should remain clear-eyed about potential problems from Huang's reinstatement. The underlying issues have not been fully resolved despite his restoration.

cards.title: Trump Called Nvidia Board to Support Huang
cards.body: The president told CNBC he spoke with the board and convinced them to reinstate Huang. Trump's intervention played a key role in the CEO's return.

cards.title: Trump Endorses Huang's Return, Cites No Evidence
cards.body: The president defended Huang's reinstatement citing the U.S. attorney general while urging continued export-control investigation. Trump's support bolstered Huang's position with Nvidia's board.

cards.title: Sierra Doubles Valuation to $30B in Six Months
cards.body: The enterprise customer experience company raised $1.75 billion in Series F funding. Sierra's valuation surge reflects surging demand for AI in customer service.

cards.title: Major Investors Bet Billions on Anthropic Pre-IPO
cards.body: Notable Capital, GIC, and Baillie Gifford backed Anthropic with significant investments before its anticipated IPO. These institutional bets demonstrate strong conviction in Anthropic's potential.

cards.title: Enterprise Networks Strain Under AI Demand
cards.body: AI deployment is becoming the biggest source of network strain for enterprises. Agentic AI tasks generate an estimated 450% more network traffic than traditional AI workloads, adding significant pressure to infrastructure.

cards.title: Data Centers Build Private Gas Power Plants
cards.body: Data center developers are bypassing long grid approval waits by building their own natural gas power plants. This behind-the-meter approach enables faster AI infrastructure deployment without decade-long connection delays.

cards.title: Philosopher Questions Anthropic's AI Consciousness Claims
cards.body: A legendary philosopher challenges Anthropic's disclosure that AI could be conscious or sentient. The debate highlights ongoing skepticism around consciousness claims in modern AI systems.

cards.title: AI Model Capabilities Continue Exponential Improvement
cards.body: METR's new report shows some AI capabilities still follow exponential growth trajectories. However, models struggle more with judgment-based tasks compared to coding and technical work.

cards.title: Tidal Bans AI-Generated Music, Deletes Tracks
cards.body: Tidal announced a ban on AI-generated music and will delete 27 million tracks from its platform. The move reflects growing music industry resistance to artificial intelligence-generated content.

cards.title: Amazon's AI Agents Exploit Zero-Day Vulnerabilities
cards.body: Amazon reports that hackers' AI agents discovered and exploited a zero-day vulnerability with minimal human input. The incident demonstrates emerging threats from autonomous AI systems in cybersecurity.

cards.title: States Sue SpaceX Over Grok's Harmful Content
cards.body: Multiple states filed lawsuits against SpaceX claiming Grok generates child sexual abuse material and revenge porn. The legal action targets AI safeguards and content moderation failures.
